run_MAGNeT_evaluation: run objective metric evaluation for a pretrained MAGNeT model on the MusicCaps 32kHz dataset
run_explorer_grid: run the Dora grid explorer to launch SLURM jobs evaluating multiple MAGNeT pretrained models
run_10sec_model_eval: run evaluation on the 10-second MAGNeT small or medium pretrained models with segment duration config
run_30sec_model_eval: run evaluation on the 30-second MAGNeT small or medium pretrained models with FSDP enabled
review_eval_function: review the eval function that binds launcher options for dataset, solver, and FAD metric configuration
